title: Powercity Flex Protocol (PulseChain) — Liquity v1 fork; $0 live E-U, latent 420s oracle-manipulation path

category_notes.E-U: No net-positive unprivileged path at the live state: no trove below 110% (min ICR 138.2%), redemption negative (HEXDC $1.0381 vs $1.0308 oracle payout), setAddresses onlyOwner+renounced, HEXDC minters immutable. Oracle-manipulation path is fork-proven mechanically but economically implausible (needs $1.2-1.6M dumped and held 421s against arbitrage).
category_notes.H-O: Holder-recoverable balances: borrowers' collateral equity ~$608,028 (265.92M HEX market value $659,890 minus 49,959 HEXDC debt $51,863) + StabilityPool deposits $8,013 + staked FLEX $62,017 + staking fee balances $3,398 + farm LP deposits $23,639 + CollSurplusPool $2,084.
category_notes.P: PriceFeed admin EOA 0x751029C76DC1841fd8E9EF658eDD6d2dCDb1e07B (updateAdmin, admin-only fn) and TimelockController 0x16986F263b9AcC844Ae3bB903155352F415CD9DC (updatePriceFeed on TroveManager). No direct fund custody.

closed_reasons: No trove below MCR 110% at live oracle price (min ICR 138.15%, system TCR 1282.4%) — no liquidations possible
Redemption arbitrage negative: 1 HEXDC redeems for $1.0308 of HEX at market while HEXDC trades at $1.0381
TroveManager/BorrowerOperations setAddresses is onlyOwner and calls _renounceOwnership() (owner = 0x0) — no re-init attack
HEXDC (LUSDToken) mint/burn addresses are constructor-immutable (TM/SP/BO) — no mint path
PriceFeed fetchPrice() is permissionless but its 420s-minimum TWAP window defeats flash-loan manipulation; a sustained 421s deep crash is required and is economically implausible (arbitrage gate)
StabilityPool/LQTYStaking/farm entry points are self-only; fee functions are caller-gated
No weakened ICR/TCR guards found in the fork's modified Liquity v1 code paths
key_facts: Live custody re-verified at block 27,771,631: ActivePool 265,923,978.026 HEX (8 dec) ≈ $659,900 at $0.0024815; 21 troves; 49,959.028 HEXDC debt; SP 7,719.327 HEXDC; staked FLEX 80,176,596.28 ≈ $62,017; farms ≈ $23,639; CollSurplusPool 839,729.937 HEX ≈ $2,084.

PriceFeed 0x5f2529BC80bB9C0Bd7C417EA78CE2Cd6114B112C is UNVERIFIED; mechanics recovered via selectors/disassembly/debug_traceCall: 4 PulseX-V2 TWAPs blended (0.65 HEX/WPLS V1 + 0.35 V2) x (0.60 WPLS/DAI + 0.40 WPLS/USDC); observations roll only when now-lastUpdate >= 420s; fetchPrice() is permissionless and stores to slot 4.

Fork PoC (real contracts, no mocks): a 421s-sustained crash to 8.25% of live price makes trove #9 liquidatable at ICR 105.9% in recovery mode -> StabilityPool receives 90,391,079 HEX ($224k) for burning 17,055.92 HEXDC; attacker (72% of SP) claimable 65,218,813 HEX ($162k).
Fork PoC: crash to 13.0% (TCR 166%, normal mode) -> redeemCollateral(20,000 HEXDC) returns 50,777,608 HEX ($126k) = 6.11x the live-price payout.

Crash cost: dumping the 2 HEX/WPLS pools to 8.2% requires ~625M HEX ($1.55M) for a recoverable ~$441k of WPLS; the trove-#9 capture band is narrow (f in 0.0780-0.0858); outside it the fork's recovery-mode branches return pure redistribution (ICR<=100%) or 'nothing to liquidate' (trove #9 marginally above system TCR).
Only ~15,551 of 49,959 HEXDC is on-market in a thin pool (buying 10,000 costs ~$29k, avg $2.90); acquiring large HEXDC amounts at ~$1.04 is not possible on-chain.
Redemptions skip troves below MCR and require system TCR > MCR; the fee for a large redemption is ~0.5% + redeemedFraction/2 (e.g. ~20.5% for 20,000/49,959).
Oracle last direct poke 2026-08-06; trove operations (2026-10-10/11) keep observations fresh; oracle lags market by ~2.9% but no profitable edge exists.
caveats: The fork PoC proves mechanics, not real-world economics: it warps 421s to simulate a sustained crash. The decisive arbitrage-response gate cannot be fork-verified.
PriceFeed is unverified; a hidden admin path cannot be fully excluded (owner/admin are EOAs).
Farm contracts are unverified; classified H-O from standard Synthetix selectors.
USD values at 2026-10-11 DefiLlama prices; triage's $730,044 used slightly different prices.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Powercity Flex: the system is solvent (1282% TCR, no trove below 110%), redemptions are negative, and all admin/init paths are closed/renounced; the only latent path is a fork-proven 420s TWAP oracle takeover that requires a $1.2-1.6M sustained crash and is not net-profitable against arbitrage.
